title: AskToolInput
description: Input of the `kai_ask` tool: one to four questions for the user. The call is NOT answered by the host at once: the turn ends, the user answers in a panel above the prompt, and their answers become this call's tool result.

questions.description: One to four questions, asked together. Ask only what you cannot decide yourself.

id.description: Optional stable id for the question, unique within this call. Defaults to q0, q1, ... by position.

header.description: A short label for the question, shown as a tab. At most 12 characters.

kind.description: `choice`: pick from options. `confirm`: approve or deny. `tasks`: tick any of a checklist. `text`: a free-text answer. `form`: several typed fields, described by `fields`.

multiSelect.description: `choice` only: let the user pick more than one option.

options.description: `choice`: two to six options. `tasks`: one to twelve items. `confirm`: optional, a pair of labels replacing Approve and Deny. The user can always answer in their own words instead, so do not add an Other option.

label.description: The option, in a few words. This exact text comes back as the answer.

description.description: One line on what choosing it means.

preview.description: Optional plain text shown beside the options while this one is focused, for example a code snippet or a sample. Not markdown.

placeholder.description: `text` only: hint text for the empty answer box.

fields.description: `form` only: the fields to collect, as a JSON Schema object (`type: object`, `properties`, `required`) in the subset the kit's form understands.

required.description: Whether the user must answer before submitting. Defaults to true.
